payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet bowl.
outcome.target: A recognizable frog visibly placed within the open toilet bowl, not merely on the lid, rim, tank, or nearby floor.
outcome.reference: The toilet and open bowl in the input image.

check.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly placed inside the open toilet bowl?
check.complete_when: At least one recognizable frog is visibly within the toilet bowl opening, positioned inside the bowl rather than on the lid, rim, tank, or nearby floor.
check.partial_when: A frog has been added to the toilet area but is only on the lid, rim, tank, or nearby floor, with no frog clearly inside the bowl.
check.absent_when: There is confident evidence that no frog has been added to or placed at the toilet.
check.unknown_when: The toilet bowl or relevant area cannot be assessed, or the evidence is ambiguous.

response.content: {"status":"complete","evidence":"The edited image shows a recognizable green frog clearly inside the open toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby floor."}

parsed.evidence: The edited image shows a recognizable green frog clearly inside the open toilet bowl; additional frogs appear on the lid and nearby floor.
